channel.title: Paksh: Science & Tech
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.description: AI company Anthropic announced that new security measures have significantly reduced "distillation attacks" against its Claude models, reporting a reduction of up to 99%. Distillation attacks are a method used to extract information from… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: EU Tech Chief Assesses Readiness Against AI Risks
item.description: The European Union's tech chief has stated that the bloc is 'well equipped' to counter the risks posed by artificial intelligence. This assessment comes as concerns grow regarding potential dangers from AI technologies. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Nikon has disqualified the winner of its Small World in Motion science competition after microscopy experts raised concerns on social media about the accuracy of the submitted clip. The company confirmed the winning entry was AI-generated… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Margaret Hamilton, an American scientist who was instrumental in developing the software for NASA's Apollo missions, has died at the age of 90. Her work was crucial for ensuring the success of lunar landings. Hamilton's contributions to… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: OpenAI's New Release Stuns, Devastates Mathematics Community
item.description: OpenAI's recent release has caused significant disruption and shock within the mathematics community, with reactions described as 'breathtaking' and 'devastating'. The new development is seen as a major event impacting the field. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.
